title: Fold Observatory
text: A Fold Observatory has two plazas, one on the cave floor and one near its ceiling. The lower plaza adjoins a storeroom; the upper plaza adjoins a cave-facing observation room. Their central stable gates are already linked.

Each room contains a treasure orb with spatial resources: Paradox Dust, Infused Crystals, Spatial Crystals, Fold Points and occasional Space Microcores. The upper room may also contain a Spatial Remnant.
